title: Correct displacement magnitude
description: Essential: Student must calculate displacement as 4 m (straight-line distance from A to C).

title: Correct distance traveled
description: Essential: Student must calculate total path length as 2πR ≈ 6.28 m.

title: Average velocity calculation
description: Important: Student applies definition v_avg = displacement/time to obtain 0.8 m/s.

title: Average speed calculation
description: Important: Student applies definition speed_avg = distance/time to obtain 1.256 m/s.

title: Direction consideration
description: Optional: Student notes displacement direction (rightward) or includes vector notation.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Student includes correct units (m, m/s) in all final answers.

title: Confusing distance with displacement
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly uses circumference (2πR) for displacement or diameter (4R) for distance.

title: Mixing velocity and speed formulas
description: Pitfall: Student swaps formulas, calculating velocity as distance/time or speed as displacement/time.
